title: InMoov Project: Computer-Vision-Controlled Robotic Arm

information.value: Personal Project - Presented at the Fête de la Science, Rouen 2023

Contactless control using computer vision / SLS nylon printed arm / 3S6P 18650 battery pack / Charging through an integrated and accessible BMS / Custom laser-cut base and protective enclosure / Arm protection during exhibitions
Arduino Nano / Camera and computer vision / Servomotors / 3S6P 18650 battery pack / Integrated BMS with accessible charging port / SLS nylon 3D printing / Laser-cut base and protective enclosure

description: This project is a redesign and improvement of the InMoov robotic arm, initially adapted for presentation at the Fête de la Science in Rouen 2023. The first version used a glove fitted with flexible sensors to reproduce hand movements.

Following the first exhibitions, we replaced the glove with a computer vision control system. This contactless solution avoids lending the glove to visitors for hygiene reasons and protects the flexible sensors, which were too fragile for repeated handling.

The arm was then fully reprinted in SLS nylon to improve its strength, finish, and movement precision. It is powered by 18650 cells in a 3S6P configuration, combined with an integrated BMS and a charging port directly accessible from the base.

The supporting box and the protective enclosure were custom-made using laser cutting. The enclosure keeps the arm clearly visible while protecting it from handling, impacts, and damage during exhibitions and trade shows.
This project allowed me to develop skills in mechatronics, embedded electronics, computer vision, energy management, SLS 3D printing, and design for laser cutting.
